listen_addr.description: Network address and port the daemon listens on. Use 0.0.0.0:8443 for all interfaces.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for local client communication.

trust_password.description: Password required to add new servers or clients to the trust model. Leave blank to require manual certificate trust.

storage_backend.description: Storage backend for instances. Common values: dir, zfs, btrfs, lvm, ceph. Choose 'dir' for single-server, simple setups.

storage_pool.description: Name of storage pool to use (ignored for 'dir' backend).

storage_dir.description: Directory root for the 'dir' storage backend. Must exist and be writable.

logging_format.description: Format for daemon logs: human-readable 'text' or structured 'json'.

log_path.description: Path for daemon log file. Use '-' to log to stdout/stderr.

max_instances.description: Maximum total number of containers and VMs the daemon will allow.

image_aliases.description: Map of image aliases to full image fingerprints or remote:alias.

allowed_image_servers.description: Whitelist of image servers allowed for import (e.g., 'images.linuxcontainers.org').

features.description: Enable or disable experimental or optional features.

cluster_server.description: Server address (IP:port) to join an existing cluster. Leave blank for standalone mode.

cluster_role.description: Role of this node in a cluster: 'member', 'database', or empty if standalone.

cluster_certificate.description: Path to cluster certificate file (for cluster joining).

default_profiles.description: Profiles automatically applied to new containers/VMs if none specified.
